text: Solicitors and accountants across Darlington, Durham and Newcastle depend on every call being answered and recorded properly. A cloud phone system from Blake Telecom lets your team take calls on a desk phone, laptop or mobile, with call routing that sends each client to the right person. Most customers are live within minutes. Ask our friendly team how it could work for your practice.

Financial firms in Edinburgh, Glasgow and Aberdeen need calls that are clear, reliable and easy to review. Our cloud phone systems offer call recording with storage from 30 days up to 10 years, so your team can keep the records your business needs. Staff can work from the office or at home on the same number. See how Blake Telecom can support your firm.

Housing associations and property firms in London, Kent and Surrey take repair requests and tenant queries all day. A cloud phone system helps your team route those calls to the right person, record them for reference and answer from the office or on site. Our UK team looks after you from first quote to go live. Ask how Blake Telecom could help your organisation.

Public sector teams and charities in Cardiff, Swansea and Newport need phone systems that are simple to manage. A cloud system keeps every call on one clear platform, and changes are quick when colleagues join or move. Blake Telecom supports organisations across Wales and the rest of the UK. Get in touch for a friendly conversation about what you need.

Video calls that freeze and files that take an age to send usually point to a struggling connection. Blake Telecom supplies business broadband across the UK, including full fibre to the premises where it is available, and we explain the options in plain English. Send us your postcode and we will check what can be installed at your address.

Some businesses outgrow ordinary broadband. A leased line gives your office a dedicated connection with the same speed in both directions, which suits busy teams, cloud software and constant video calls. Blake Telecom arranges leased lines for firms in Manchester and well beyond, and looks after the order from start to finish. Ask us whether it is the right step for you.

Blake Telecom has been supplying business phone systems since 2004. We are a small, friendly UK team, so when you call you speak to someone who knows your account and can answer your questions. We look after you from the first quote through to going live and beyond. If you would like a chat about your phones or your connection, we would be glad to hear from you.

A busy phone line should not feel like a queue to nowhere. Our contact centre tools let you set up call queues, send callers to the right team and see how many calls are coming in. Blake Telecom sets the system up and tests it before it reaches you, so your team can start taking calls quickly. Ask us for a friendly demonstration.

Your team is out and about, so their phones should work as hard as they do. Blake Telecom supplies business mobiles and SIMs that we look after alongside your office phone system, so you have one supplier to call if anything needs attention. Talk to us about what your team needs on the road.

Does your team already live in Microsoft Teams? You can take phone calls there too. Blake Telecom connects your business number to Teams, so staff use one app for chat, meetings and calls while customers keep ringing the number they know. Get in touch to see how it would fit the way you work.
